decision.observation: Strike on the emblem pillar produced nothing; Hornet stands on the terrace beside it. Below-right, a cobblestone path runs along mossy ground at the bottom-right corner of the chamber, with green motes.
decision.hypothesis: The terraces are a dead end; the bottom cobblestone path continuing west is the actual route onward in this new region. Descend down-right to it, then continue west.
decision.memory: New region: bottom path continues west; terraces dead-end.
